results.name: Dumbbell Bench Seated Press
instructions: Sit on a flat bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended, ensuring your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with a controlled motion. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your elbows do not flare out excessively; keep them slightly in front of your body.
Avoid arching your lower back; keep your core engaged and back pressed against the bench.
Breathe out as you press the dumbbells upward and breathe in as you lower them back down.
results.description: Dumbbell Bench Seated Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Bent Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand, elbows bent at a 90-degree angle and palms facing your body.
Engage your core and keep your back straight. Raise your upper arms to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, keeping your elbows bent at 90 degrees throughout the movement.
Lower your arms back to the starting position with a controlled motion. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum; perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
Ensure your elbows remain at a 90-degree angle throughout the exercise.
Do not raise your arms above shoulder height to avoid unnecessary stress on your shoulder joints.
results.description: Dumbbell Bent Arm Lateral Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Rotator Cuff.

results.name: Dumbbell Bent Over Face Pull
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing back). Bend at your hips and knees to lower your torso until it is parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight.
Let the dumbbells hang directly below your shoulders, elbows slightly bent.
Pull the dumbbells upward to the ceiling, bending your elbows and bringing them as high as possible and facing outward. Make sure to lead the dumbbells at face level.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with a controlled motion. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum; perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
Breathe out as you pull the dumbbells towards your face and breathe in as you lower them back down.
Use a weight that allows you to perform the exercise with proper form without straining.
results.description: Dumbbell Bent Over Face Pull is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl to Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip (palms facing forward). Keep your elbows close to your torso.
Perform bicep curls by bending your elbows to lift the dumbbells towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms stationary.
As you reach the top of the curl, rotate your wrists so that your palms face forward and press the dumbbells overhead by extending your arms fully.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height, then rotate your wrists back to the starting position and lower the dumbbells back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your body during the bicep curl and ensure they don’t flare out during the shoulder press.
Exhale as you press the dumbbells overhead and inhale as you lower them.
Start with a lighter weight to master the technique before progressing to heavier weights.
results.description: Dumbbell Bicep Curl to Shoulder Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Chest Supported Lateral Raises
instructions: Lie face-down on an incline bench with your chest and stomach supported by the bench, and your feet firmly planted on the floor. Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms extended straight down.
Slowly raise the dumbbells in an arc over your head and towards your back, maintaining a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring the dumbbell back to the starting position by reversing the arc motion, focusing on engaging your back and shoulder muscles.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining control throughout the exercise.
tips: Keep a firm grip on the dumbbell to maintain control and prevent it from slipping.
Avoid raising the dumbbell too far to prevent shoulder strain.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce stress on your joints.
results.description: Dumbbell Chest Supported Lateral Raises is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Chest Supported Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest fully supported. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, in a neutral grip and allow your arms to hang straight toward the floor with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise both dumbbells diagonally upward and outward, while rotating the weight until your arms form a Y shape with your body, finishing the movement with palms facing down.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest in contact with the bench throughout the exercise.
Use light weights to maintain proper technique and a full range of motion.
Avoid swinging the dumbbells or using momentum.
Inhale as you lower the dumbbells and exhale as you raise them.
results.description: Dumbbell Chest Supported Y Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Rotator Cuff, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Close Grip Shoulder Press Sit Up
instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a close grip, elbows bent at 90 degrees resting on the floor.
Engage your core and perform a sit-up by raising your torso towards your knees while simultaneously pressing the dumbbells overhead.
Lower your torso back to the starting position while bringing the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining control throughout the exercise.
tips: Maintain a close grip on the dumbbells to ensure proper shoulder engagement.
Engage your core throughout the movement to support your lower back.
Keep your feet firmly planted on the floor to stabilize your body during the sit-up.
results.description: Dumbbell Close Grip Shoulder Press Sit Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Cuban Press (Version 2)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip. Let your arms hang straight down in front of your thighs.
Raise your elbows to shoulder height, keeping your arms bent at a 90-degree angle, forming a "goalpost" position with your forearms perpendicular to your body.
Rotate your shoulders to lift the dumbbells upward until your forearms are vertical.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended. Reverse the movement to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum; use controlled movements to lift and lower the dumbbells.
Keep your core engaged and maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
Start with a lighter weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase as you become more comfortable.
results.description: Dumbbell Cuban Press (Version 2) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Rotator Cuff.

results.name: Dumbbell Decline Shrug
instructions: Begin by lying chest first on an incline bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms extended straight down toward the floor, palms facing each other.
Allow your shoulders to relax downward, feeling a stretch in your upper traps.
Lift your shoulders upward towards your ears, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Inhale and slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
tips: Avoid using your arms to lift the weights; focus on lifting with your shoulders.
Concentrate on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Ensure your head and neck remain in a neutral position to avoid strain.
results.description: Dumbbell Decline Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell External Rotation (Single Rep)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand. Keep your opposite hand behind your back for support.
Start with your working arm bent at a 90-degree angle, elbow close to your side, forearm parallel to the floor facing forward with the dumbbell held in a neutral position.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping your elbow fixed in place, until your palm faces forward.
Slowly return to the starting position, bringing your forearm back to starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
tips: Keep your wrist straight and aligned with your forearm to avoid strain.
Avoid rotating your torso; focus on moving just your forearm.
Perform the exercise in front of a mirror to ensure proper form and alignment.
results.description: Dumbbell External Rotation (Single Rep) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Rear Shoulders.
